evidence.reason: The current code still loads and verifies the helper at lines 2490-2491 before validating the switch argument combination at lines 2492-2494. Thus an invalid invocation like switch --unit without --runtime raises Refused after helper loading instead of taking the parser's usage-error path. This can also mask the argument error behind a missing or SHA-mismatched helper. Moving the switch argument checks before _load_helper and routing them through parser.error is the minimal correctness fix; no owner decision is needed.
